title: Fixed 8-entry id buffer silently disables the pullback when a fed slice exceeds 8 spawn events
detail: If one fed slice ever carries more than 8 NODE_SPAWNED events (batched steps on a slow frame, a large catch-up window), the walk stops at 8, found differs from n_spawns, and the feed silently returns — the seed pullback never fires.
recommended_fix: Bound the walk by n_spawns with a dynamically sized buffer, or chunk the mapping; at minimum document the 8-spawn cap and log/telemetry when it trips.

title: PP_CAM_E2E injects a second Mouse_Move into frames that already carry the poll's per-frame move, breaking the W5 fixed-buffer invariant
detail: The e2e drive runs the real poll (a Mouse_Move every frame) and appends another into the same buffer at CAM_E2E_PAN_MOVE — two moves in one frame. The moves buffer is fixed sized per that exact invariant; moves[moves_n] has no visible bounds guard.
recommended_fix: Bounds-check moves_n against len(moves) in mouse_map, or verify the buffer holds multiple moves; alternatively gate the poll's move during scripted e2e frames.

title: camera_set_selection's deselect-to-fit path is not shown to clear the pullback flag
evidence:
app.cam_zoom_to = 2.3
+			app.pullback = false
---
+				app.pullback = false // Perkins r2 W3: the pipe leg yields a pullback too
---
+W8's seven pullback-yield clears (wheel, pan, node-select, pipe-select,
+alerts-as-nav, ESC home, settings toggle), W9's positive two-finger pan deltas,
detail: Clears were added to the node and pipe branches (and camera_set_fit), but the nothing-selected fall-through to fit is outside the shown hunks, and the pinned seven-clear list omits deselect — an in-flight pullback could keep the slow rate.
recommended_fix: Route the deselect fall-through through camera_set_fit (or clear app.pullback there) and add the deselect leg to the W8 pin.

title: PP_CAM_E2E environment string allocated then discarded without free
detail: get_env_alloc returns an owned string; it is compared and dropped without free. A one-shot startup leak — trivial, but the same class this codebase folds elsewhere (N6).
recommended_fix: Free the returned string after the comparison, or use a non-allocating env check.

title: Duplicated fragment in camera_zoom_step doc comment
evidence: +// camera_zoom_step — z scaled by one wheel notch of `delta` (positive = in). of `delta` (positive = in).
detail: The comment sentence repeats 'of `delta` (positive = in).' — a copy-paste artifact in a file whose comments otherwise serve as load-bearing documentation.

title: PR-body verification counts contradict the shipped test files
detail: The '4 + 4 + 4 + 2' counts are pre-fold story counts; the diff ships 9 camera-math, 7 input-wiring, and 10 pullback @(test) procs after the r2/r3 additions. Stale verification claims.
recommended_fix: Update the Verification bullet to the actual per-file test counts, or drop the counts.
